rationale: Z has a clean hero with a clear floor-plan card, strong colour rhythm (dark, terracotta and green bands) and tidy mobile stacking, though the Resident price looks slightly garbled. X is a polished, consistent cream, rust and slate page with a believable live floor plan, but its layout is the most conventional. Y is the most inventive (dot-grid metrics, weekday chips, tilted resident card), but the hero overlay collides with the caption text and clips 'Darkroom', and mobile is very long with weaker polish.
